ModMetaData.name: RimTalk Custom Events
ModMetaData.author: Ethan
ModMetaData.description:
Companion mod for RimTalk. Write your own multi-phase, LLM-driven pawn events.
Each event has three beats: - BEGINNING fires once and starts the event. - CONTINUE repeats through the day, escalating. - END resolves it, and can leave a hediff or a reward behind.
Events are stored as JSON files and can fire daily, occasionally, or on the storyteller's schedule.
Requires RimTalk.
